digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration - Bedrock parity measurement
propositions: Bedrock must be measured against a non-inferiority parity bar before being promoted to a first-class provider in S8
Payload and tool parity must be proven by capturing actual outbound requests on both providers, showing they are byte-identical except for the model ID and documented envelope differences
Provider routing must be clean with zero non-Bedrock calls on the Bedrock-configured arm across the entire corpus run

Temperature capability differences are model-driven not provider-driven: opus withdraws temperature on both providers while sonnet sends it on both, driven by the existing supports_temperature override
The corpus must pool eligible gold cases across 15+ specs reaching the MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20, excluding agentic disposable-store arms that bypass gate_config resolution
Both Bedrock inference-profile IDs must be invokable in account 896586841071 / us-east-1 with no access errors before corpus spend, probed twice each (bare and with temperature=0)
